“Poorest” here means the lowest household final consumption per person among countries in the source table. Values are adjusted for purchasing power, not market exchange rates. Each country's latest listed year is shown; the years differ. North America includes Central America and the Caribbean. Kosovo is included in Europe, and Timor-Leste in Asia. Small-country and territory markers are enlarged for visibility; short lines connect displaced markers to their locations.
